messages:
maria: Kicking off blue->green swap for router v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 in 10m change window. Planned steps:
- pin client vhosts to new backend
- staged traffic shift: 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- drain old green once 100% stable

aj: Roger. I'll watch p50/p99 and error-rate. Staying on-call during shift.

deploy-bot: [deploy] shift initiated: cohort=api, from=green(3.2.1) to=blue(3.3.0), target=10%

ryan: Can we confirm rollout policy uses automatic fallback to 3.2.1 if errors > 2% for 5m?

maria: yes. rollback triggers are: 
- 5m error rate > 2% OR
- p99 latency increase > 200ms sustained for 10m OR
- any 5xx spike > 30/min

sara: Note: 3.3.0 includes a header-key rename (x-rw-client -> x-rw-cid). I patched client compat rules but shout if something odd.

aj: I've subscribed #incidents to alerts. If we need a rollback I'll run the router rollback helper.

aj: ```bash
/router rollback --target green --reason "error spike"
```

deploy-bot: 10% shift complete. metrics: error_rate=0.12%, p50=22ms, p99=110ms :thumbsup:

maria: Plan to move to 50% in 5m unless we see degradation. @aj @ryan any objections?

ryan: No objections. go.

deploy-bot: 50% shift complete. metrics: error_rate=0.35%, p50=24ms, p99=140ms

aj: slight p99 bump but within thresholds. continue to 100% in 3m.

deploy-bot: 100% shift complete. all traffic on blue(3.3.0). scheduled drain of green in 15m.

maria: Post-deploy checklist: pin routing-table keys, update prod release notes to include "router 3.3.0: improved batching, header fix" and tag infra/router@3.3.0 in git.

sara: I'll update the release notes and send a short customer-facing blurb within the change window.

aj: Monitoring for 30m for regression alerts. If any rollback threshold hit, I'll call it and run the command above.

deploy-bot: drain completed for green. old instances scaled to 0. Completed by ryan.

ryan: Confirmed. No anomalies seen in logs, load normal. Closing out from infra side.

maria: Thanks team — marking rollout success and closing change window :tada:
